Subsection 1: VPD across OzFlux
- Driver importance using random forest

Compare the importance of Temp, VPD, precipitation, cwd 7 day, LAI, and shortwave radiation 

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(caret)
library(randomForest)
library(zoo)

standardise <- function(train, test, vars_to_scale) {
  # Fit scaling on train only, apply to both - avoids data leakage
  scale_params <- lapply(vars_to_scale, function(v) {
    list(mean = mean(train[[v]], na.rm = TRUE),
         sd   = sd(train[[v]], na.rm = TRUE))
  })
  names(scale_params) <- vars_to_scale
  
  for (v in vars_to_scale) {
    train[[v]] <- (train[[v]] - scale_params[[v]]$mean) / scale_params[[v]]$sd
    test[[v]]  <- (test[[v]]  - scale_params[[v]]$mean) / scale_params[[v]]$sd
  }
  list(train = train, test = test)
}

run_rf_for_site <- function(df, site_name) {
  
  df <- df %>% drop_na()
  
  if (nrow(df) < 100) {
    warning(paste("Site", site_name, "has insufficient data:", nrow(df), "rows"))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Add lagged variables and rolling CWD
  df <- df %>%
    arrange(date) %>%
    mutate(
      cumulative_cwd_7day = rollapply(cwd, width = 7, FUN = sum,
                                      align = "right", fill = NA, na.rm = TRUE),
      Tair_lag1 = lag(Tair, 1),
      Tair_lag2 = lag(Tair, 2),
      Tair_lag3 = lag(Tair, 3),
      VPD_lag1  = lag(VPD, 1),
      VPD_lag2  = lag(VPD, 2),
      VPD_lag3  = lag(VPD, 3)
    ) %>%
    drop_na()
  
  # Train/test split
  set.seed(123)
  idx        <- createDataPartition(df$GPP, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
  train_data <- df[idx, ]
  test_data  <- df[-idx, ]
  
  predictors <- c("Tair", "SW_rad", "VPD", "Precip", "cumulative_cwd_7day"
                )
  
  # Scale train, apply same params to test
  scaled     <- standardise(train_data, test_data, predictors)
  train_data <- scaled$train
  test_data  <- scaled$test
  
  # Fit RF
  model <- randomForest(
    GPP ~ Tair + SW_rad + VPD + Precip + cumulative_cwd_7day,
    data  = train_data,
    ntree = 500,
    mtry  = 3,
    importance = TRUE  # needed for permutation importance
  )
  
  # Predict and metrics
  predictions    <- predict(model, test_data)
  results        <- data.frame(Observed = test_data$GPP, Predicted = predictions)
  rmse           <- sqrt(mean((results$Observed - results$Predicted)^2))
  rsq            <- cor(results$Observed, results$Predicted)^2
  mean_observed  <- mean(results$Observed)
  nse            <- 1 - sum((results$Observed - results$Predicted)^2) /
                        sum((results$Observed - mean_observed)^2)
  
  # Variable importance - use %IncMSE (permutation based, more reliable than IncNodePurity)
  imp <- importance(model, type = 1)  # type=1 is %IncMSE
  importance_df <- data.frame(
    variable   = rownames(imp),
    importance = imp[, 1],
    site       = site_name
  )
  
  return(list(
    site        = site_name,
    model       = model,
    metrics     = data.frame(site = site_name, RMSE = rmse, R2 = rsq, NSE = nse),
    importance  = importance_df,
    predictions = results %>% mutate(site = site_name)
  ))
}

# Apply to all sites
rf_results <- map2(sites_daily, names(sites_daily), run_rf_for_site)

# Remove NULLs from sites with insufficient data
rf_results <- Filter(Negate(is.null), rf_results)
cat("Sites successfully fitted:", length(rf_results), "\n")

# Extract metrics and importance
all_metrics    <- map_df(rf_results, ~.x$metrics)
all_importance <- map_df(rf_results, ~.x$importance)

print(all_metrics)

# Plot importance in groups of 6 sites
site_names <- unique(all_importance$site)
n_groups   <- ceiling(length(site_names) / 6)

for (i in 1:n_groups) {
  start_idx    <- (i - 1) * 6 + 1
  end_idx      <- min(i * 6, length(site_names))
  sites_subset <- site_names[start_idx:end_idx]
  
  p <- ggplot(all_importance %>% filter(site %in% sites_subset),
              aes(x = reorder(variable, importance), y = importance)) +
    geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
    facet_wrap(~site, scales = "free_x", ncol = 3) +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
          axis.text  = element_text(size = 8)) +
    labs(title = paste("Variable Importance - Group", i),
         x = "Variable", y = "%IncMSE")
  
  print(p)
  ggsave(paste0("importance_group_", i, ".png"), width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)
}
```

LAI interpolated looks like the most important - let's try with the raw data instead and compare

```{r}
library(zoo)

sites_daily <- map(sites_daily, function(df) {
  df %>%
    arrange(date) %>%
    mutate(LAI_step = na.locf(LAI_4day, na.rm = FALSE))
})
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(caret)
library(randomForest)
library(zoo)

standardise <- function(train, test, vars_to_scale) {
  # Fit scaling on train only, apply to both - avoids data leakage
  scale_params <- lapply(vars_to_scale, function(v) {
    list(mean = mean(train[[v]], na.rm = TRUE),
         sd   = sd(train[[v]], na.rm = TRUE))
  })
  names(scale_params) <- vars_to_scale
  
  for (v in vars_to_scale) {
    train[[v]] <- (train[[v]] - scale_params[[v]]$mean) / scale_params[[v]]$sd
    test[[v]]  <- (test[[v]]  - scale_params[[v]]$mean) / scale_params[[v]]$sd
  }
  list(train = train, test = test)
}

run_rf_for_site <- function(df, site_name) {
  
  required_vars <- c("GPP", "Tair", "SW_rad", "VPD", "Precip", 
                    "cwd", "date")
  
  df <- df %>% drop_na(all_of(required_vars))  # only drop NAs in relevant columns
  
  if (nrow(df) < 100) {
    warning(paste("Site", site_name, "has insufficient data:", nrow(df), "rows"))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # rest of function unchanged...
  
  # Add lagged variables and rolling CWD
  df <- df %>%
    arrange(date) %>%
    mutate(
      cumulative_cwd_7day = rollapply(cwd, width = 7, FUN = sum,
                                      align = "right", fill = NA, na.rm = TRUE),
      Tair_lag1 = lag(Tair, 1),
      Tair_lag2 = lag(Tair, 2),
      Tair_lag3 = lag(Tair, 3),
      VPD_lag1  = lag(VPD, 1),
      VPD_lag2  = lag(VPD, 2),
      VPD_lag3  = lag(VPD, 3)
    ) %>%
    drop_na()
  
  # Train/test split
  set.seed(123)
  idx        <- createDataPartition(df$GPP, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
  train_data <- df[idx, ]
  test_data  <- df[-idx, ]
  
  predictors <- c("Tair", "SW_rad", "VPD", "Precip", "cumulative_cwd_7day")
  
  # Scale train, apply same params to test
  scaled     <- standardise(train_data, test_data, predictors)
  train_data <- scaled$train
  test_data  <- scaled$test
  
  # Fit RF
  model <- randomForest(
    GPP ~ Tair + SW_rad + VPD + Precip + cumulative_cwd_7day,
    data  = train_data,
    ntree = 500,
    mtry  = 3,
    importance = TRUE  # needed for permutation importance
  )
  
  # Predict and metrics
  predictions    <- predict(model, test_data)
  results        <- data.frame(Observed = test_data$GPP, Predicted = predictions)
  rmse           <- sqrt(mean((results$Observed - results$Predicted)^2))
  rsq            <- cor(results$Observed, results$Predicted)^2
  mean_observed  <- mean(results$Observed)
  nse            <- 1 - sum((results$Observed - results$Predicted)^2) /
                        sum((results$Observed - mean_observed)^2)
  
  # Variable importance - use %IncMSE (permutation based, more reliable than IncNodePurity)
  imp <- importance(model, type = 1)  # type=1 is %IncMSE
  importance_df <- data.frame(
    variable   = rownames(imp),
    importance = imp[, 1],
    site       = site_name
  )
  
  return(list(
    site        = site_name,
    model       = model,
    metrics     = data.frame(site = site_name, RMSE = rmse, R2 = rsq, NSE = nse),
    importance  = importance_df,
    predictions = results %>% mutate(site = site_name)
  ))
}

# Apply to all sites
rf_results <- map2(sites_daily, names(sites_daily), run_rf_for_site)

# Remove NULLs from sites with insufficient data
rf_results <- Filter(Negate(is.null), rf_results)
cat("Sites successfully fitted:", length(rf_results), "\n")

# Extract metrics and importance

all_importance <- map_df(rf_results, ~.x$importance)

print(all_metrics)

# Plot importance in groups of 6 sites

n_groups   <- ceiling(length(site_names) / 6)

for (i in 1:n_groups) {
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Normalise importance within each site (0-1) so sites are comparable
all_importance_norm <- all_importance %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  mutate(importance_norm = (importance - min(importance)) / 
                           (max(importance) - min(importance))) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(all_importance_norm, aes(x = variable, y = site, fill = importance_norm)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = "YlOrRd", direction = 1,
                       name = "Relative\nImportance") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9)) +
  labs(x = "Predictor", y = "Site", 
       title = "RF Predictor Importance Across Australian Flux Sites")
```
```{r}

wet_dry_order <- c("Wac", "Rob", "How", "Das", "Fog", "Ade", "Dap", "Rdf", "Wom", "Tum", "Dry", "Stp", "Gin", "Cum", "Emr", "Rig", "Whr", "Asm", "Gww", "Cpr", "Ync")

all_importance_norm <- all_importance_norm %>%
  mutate(site = factor(site, levels = rev(wet_dry_order)))  # rev() so wet is at top

# Step 4: Plot with actual importance values on scale
ggplot(all_importance_norm, aes(x = variable, y = site, fill = importance_norm)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c("#313695", "#4575b4", "#74add1", "#abd9e9",
                "#ffffbf", "#fdae61", "#f46d43", "#d73027", "#a50026"),
    name = "Normalised\nImportance",
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25),
    labels = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25)  # actual numbers
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9),
        axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 9),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 9),
        panel.grid   = element_blank()) +
  labs(x = "Predictor", y = "Site (Dry to Wet)",
       title = "Predictor Importance Across Australian Flux Sites")
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)

# Get the most important predictor per site
top_predictor <- all_importance %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  slice_max(importance, n = 1) %>%
  ungroup()

# Join with site coordinates
top_predictor <- top_predictor %>%
  left_join(site_meta %>% rename(site = name), by = "site")

# Get Australia shapefile
australia <- ne_countries(country = "Australia", scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

# Define colours per predictor - adjust as needed once you see what comes out
predictor_colours <- c(
  "LAI_step"           = "#2d8b4e",
  "SW_rad"             = "#f5a623",
  "Tair"               = "#d0021b",
  "VPD"                = "#9b59b6",
  "cumulative_cwd_7day"= "#3498db",
  "Precip"             = "#1abc9c"
)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = australia, fill = "grey90", colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(data = top_predictor,
             aes(x = lon, y = lat, colour = variable, shape = variable),
             size = 5) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = predictor_colours, name = "Top Predictor") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = rep(c(16, 17, 15, 18, 8), length.out = 9),
                     name = "Top Predictor") +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(112, 155), ylim = c(-45, -10)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position   = "right",
    legend.title      = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.text       = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.text         = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.title        = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")
  ) +
  labs(title = "Most Important GPP Predictor by Flux Site",
       x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude")

ggsave("australia_top_predictor_map.png", width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
                     name = "Top Predictor") +

       x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude")
```

Looking at LAI as the response

```{r}
run_rf_for_site_LAI <- function(df, site_name) {
  
  required_vars <- c("LAI_filled", "Tair", "SW_rad", "VPD", "Precip", "cwd", "date")
  
  df <- df %>% drop_na(all_of(required_vars))
  
  if (nrow(df) < 100) {
    warning(paste("Site", site_name, "has insufficient data:", nrow(df), "rows"))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  df <- df %>%
    arrange(date) %>%
    mutate(
      cumulative_cwd_7day = rollapply(cwd, width = 7, FUN = sum,
                                      align = "right", fill = NA, na.rm = TRUE),
      Tair_lag1 = lag(Tair, 1),
      Tair_lag2 = lag(Tair, 2),
      Tair_lag3 = lag(Tair, 3),
      VPD_lag1  = lag(VPD, 1),
      VPD_lag2  = lag(VPD, 2),
      VPD_lag3  = lag(VPD, 3)
    ) %>%
    drop_na()
  
  set.seed(123)
  idx        <- createDataPartition(df$LAI_filled, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
  train_data <- df[idx, ]
  test_data  <- df[-idx, ]
  
  predictors <- c("Tair", "SW_rad", "VPD", "Precip", "cumulative_cwd_7day")
  
  scaled     <- standardise(train_data, test_data, predictors)
  train_data <- scaled$train
  test_data  <- scaled$test
  
  model <- randomForest(
    LAI_filled ~ Tair + SW_rad + VPD + Precip + cumulative_cwd_7day,
    data       = train_data,
    ntree      = 500,
    mtry       = 3,
    importance = TRUE
  )
  
  predictions   <- predict(model, test_data)
  results       <- data.frame(Observed = test_data$LAI_filled, Predicted = predictions)
  rmse          <- sqrt(mean((results$Observed - results$Predicted)^2))
  rsq           <- cor(results$Observed, results$Predicted)^2
  mean_observed <- mean(results$Observed)
  nse           <- 1 - sum((results$Observed - results$Predicted)^2) /
                       sum((results$Observed - mean_observed)^2)
  
  imp <- importance(model, type = 1)
  importance_df <- data.frame(
    variable   = rownames(imp),
    importance = imp[, 1],
    site       = site_name
  )
  
  return(list(
    site        = site_name,
    model       = model,
    metrics     = data.frame(site = site_name, RMSE = rmse, R2 = rsq, NSE = nse),
    importance  = importance_df,
    predictions = results %>% mutate(site = site_name)
  ))
}

# Apply to all sites
rf_results_LAI <- map2(sites_daily, names(sites_daily), run_rf_for_site_LAI)
rf_results_LAI <- Filter(Negate(is.null), rf_results_LAI)
cat("Sites successfully fitted:", length(rf_results_LAI), "\n")

all_metrics_LAI    <- map_df(rf_results_LAI, ~.x$metrics)
all_importance_LAI <- map_df(rf_results_LAI, ~.x$importance)

print(all_metrics_LAI)
```
```{r}

# Combine GPP and LAI importance with a response label
all_importance_combined <- bind_rows(
  all_importance     %>% mutate(response = "GPP"),
  all_importance_LAI %>% mutate(response = "LAI")
)

site_names <- unique(all_importance_combined$site)
n_groups   <- ceiling(length(site_names) / 6)

for (i in 1:n_groups) {
  start_idx    <- (i - 1) * 6 + 1
  end_idx      <- min(i * 6, length(site_names))
  sites_subset <- site_names[start_idx:end_idx]
  
  p <- ggplot(all_importance_combined %>% filter(site %in% sites_subset),
              aes(x = reorder(variable, importance), y = importance, fill = response)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("GPP" = "steelblue", "LAI" = "coral")) +
    facet_wrap(~ site, scales = "free_x", ncol = 3) +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(strip.text     = element_text(size = 10),
          axis.text      = element_text(size = 8),
          legend.position = "top") +
    labs(title = paste("Variable Importance - Group", i),
         x = "Variable", y = "%IncMSE", fill = "Response")
  
  print(p)
  ggsave(paste0("importance_group_", i, ".png"), width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)
}
```
